summary: On paper New England has the edge (New England's defense ranks 2nd in EPA per dropback, +0.03 allowed), while the Jets's best counter is to win up front (The Jets' defense ranks 13th in pressure rate, 23% generated). Under center, Drake Maye ranks 10th of 23 in EPA per dropback and Geno Smith ranks 20th; x-factor: Garrett Wilson gets 31% of the Jets' targets and 40% of its air yards, and New England's pass defense ranks 2nd. The model favors New England at 80%, mostly on passing matchup (3.8 pts) and starting QB (3.6 pts).
